newsitem.title: USA: Power costs pressure Pacificorp earnings.
newsitem.headline: Power costs pressure Pacificorp earnings.

text.p: Pacificorp said Wednesday that the drop in its first quarter net income was primarily the result of higher power costs at its Hermiston generating plant and reduced industrial revenues at its domestic electric operations.
The decline in industrial revenues was the result of lower prices and volumes and non-recurring billing adjustments, it said.
In addition to higher power costs and reduced industrial revenues, PacifiCorp said its 1997 revenues will be hurt by a $9 million rate reduction implemented April 15 in Utah.
